GUI95 Reference Desktop

Original demonstration application created for the GUI95 reference collection.
Visual vocabulary: Vector95 and sausage-music / ProcGen FM.
Most SVG icon assets and the two labeled source screenshots: Vector95.
Monitor and Media Player application icons: original artwork for this demo.

MS Sans Serif regular and bold font recreations by lou.
Regular: https://fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/1384746
Bold: https://fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/1384862
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0.
The fonts are unmodified. Their complete original licenses and readmes
accompany them in assets/ms-sans-serif*.txt.

The parent collection's docs/provenance.md records the application sources,
hash manifest, and project-specific notices. Stephen Lavelle's distributed
material is covered by the parent collection's MIT license; third-party
material retains its own terms. See LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
in the parent collection.

Windows and Microsoft are trademarks of Microsoft. This is an independent
reference demonstration, not a Microsoft product or operating system emulator.
